comment: The Intel SYCL runtime files the Windows SYCL tester zip ships (ADR-1566), copied unmodified from the oneAPI installation of its hosted build (prepare_build.py intel-runtime) beside every program (build/tools, tests: Windows searches a program's own directory before System32), and the licence texts that go with them. Compiler files must be listed in its credist.txt, whose Windows entries read <installdir>/bin/<name> (the Redistributables of the Intel End User License Agreement for Developer Tools); UMF and hwloc from TCM carry their own texts, as in sycl-runtime.json. The build drops every listed DLL that no file beside the programs imports and that the SYCL runtime does not load by name (scripts/ci/build-windows-tester-bundle.py LOADED_AT_RUN_TIME), so the list holds the candidates, not a promise. Paths are relative to ONEAPI_ROOT, whose */latest links the installer creates; read from the 2025.3.0.372 offline installer's packages on 2026-10-04.
